title: CTC-TTS: LLM-based dual-streaming text-to-speech with CTC alignment
abstract: arXiv:2602.19574v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large-language-model (LLM)-based text-to-speech (TTS) systems can generate natural speech, but most are not designed for low-latency dual-streaming synthesis. High-quality dual-streaming TTS depends on accurate text--speech alignment and well-designed training sequences that balance synthesis quality and latency. Prior work often relies on GMM-HMM based forced-alignment toolkits (e.g., MFA), which are pipeline-heavy and less flexible than neural aligners; fixed-ratio interleaving of text and speech tokens struggles to capture text--speech alignment regularities. We propose CTC-TTS, which replaces MFA with a CTC based aligner and introduces a bi-word based interleaving strategy. Two variants are designed: CTC-TTS-L (token concatenation along the sequence length) for higher quality and CTC-TTS-F (embedding stacking along the feature dimension) for lower latency. translated_title: CTC-TTS：基于大语言模型、采用CTC对齐的双流文本转语音系统
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的文本转语音（TTS）系统能够生成自然的语音，但大多数系统并未针对低延迟双流合成进行设计。高质量的双流TTS依赖于准确的文本-语音对齐以及精心设计的训练序列，以在合成质量与延迟之间取得平衡。先前的工作通常依赖基于GMM-HMM的强制对齐工具包（如MFA），这类工具流程繁琐，且不如神经对齐器灵活；而文本与语音token的固定比例交错方式难以捕捉文本-语音对齐的规律。我们提出CTC-TTS，用基于CTC的对齐器取代MFA，并引入了一种基于双词的交错策略。我们设计了两种变体：CTC-TTS-L（沿序列长度进行token拼接）可实现更高质量的合成，CTC-TTS-F（沿特征维度进行嵌入堆叠）可实现更低的延迟。实验表明，CTC-TTS优于固定比例交错方法……
tldr: 提出CTC-TTS，用基于CTC的神经对齐器取代MFA并引入双词交错策略，通过序列拼接（高质量）和特征堆叠（低延迟）两种变体，实现了兼顾合成质量与延迟的LLM双流文本转语音。
en_tdlr: CTC-TTS replaces MFA with a CTC-based neural aligner and introduces a bi-word interleaving strategy, offering two variants for higher quality or lower latency to enable LLM-based dual-streaming text-to-speech synthesis.
